description: Fixed synthetic candidates for comparing the production prepared-context allocator with the evaluation-only waterfill-v1 allocator. Every body is synthetic; no case contains private content.

arms.baseline: production: PreparedContextBuilder().build_scopes_result with an internal budget recorder; selection, ordering, caps, truncation, rendering and the final byte check are the production code path.
arms.candidate: waterfill-v1: evaluation-only allocator over the same frozen candidates (the production budget trace order), the same caps, the same production truncation primitive, the same 2000-byte body quota, the same 64-byte floor for truncated bodies and the same production renderer. Phase 1 admits candidates in frozen order at their minimal honest form (the complete body when it is no larger than the smallest truncation of at least 64 bytes, otherwise that smallest truncation) only when the actual rendering of all admitted items fits max_bytes; a candidate whose minimal form does not fit is dropped_minimum_infeasible, and a candidate past its cap gets the production cap disposition. Phase 2 finds, by binary search on the actual rendering, the largest uniform body level t such that every admitted item delivered at min(complete_i, max(minimal_i, t)) fits. Phase 3 grows admitted items in frozen order, each to the longest form whose actual rendering still fits. waterfill-v1 has no tunable parameter.

scoring.position: 1-based position of a candidate in the frozen candidate order (production budget trace order).
scoring.retained_fraction_formula: (delivered display body bytes - 3 ellipsis bytes) / complete display body bytes; 1.0 when delivered complete; 0.0 when not delivered
scoring.coverage_formula: sum(weight * value) / sum(weight) over the frozen candidates of one case
scoring.fact_retained: a declared fact is retained when it occurs literally in the delivered display body of its candidate

decision.invalid_when: any validity check fails for either arm: a rendering exceeds max_bytes, a cap is exceeded, a truncated body is below 64 bytes, a delivered body is not a form produced by the production truncation primitive, the baseline re-rendered from its budget trace differs from the production content, the budget trace does not reconcile with the production counters, or a replay differs
decision.improvement_established_when: not invalid, and mean coverage_delta over primary cases is strictly greater than min_mean_coverage_delta, and top_item_truncation_loss is at most max_top_item_truncation_loss in every primary case, and in every critical case the candidate retains every fact the baseline retains
decision.sensitivity_cases: reported separately and excluded from the decision

limitations: The experiment measures allocation coverage of fixed synthetic candidates under one renderer. It does not measure answer quality, downstream model behavior, or real recall improvement.
A retained truncated prefix is credited at most half of a complete item; a prefix is never treated as a complete fact.
include_code preparations are outside the comparison; code evidence keeps its own reserved share.
